title: Figure 2

You should install following packages:
```{r}
#| code-fold: true
#| output: false
#| eval: false
pak::pak("WangLabCSU/geokit")
```

```{r}
#| code-fold: true
#| output: false
if (!dir.exists("rawdata/Figure 3")) {
    dir.create("rawdata/Figure 3", recursive = TRUE)
}
if (!dir.exists("Figure 3")) {
    dir.create("Figure 3")
}
library(geokit)
```

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
#| eval: false
# you should add environment variable 'DEEPSEEK_API_KEY'
gse_records <- geo_search("diabetes[ALL] AND Homo sapiens[ORGN] AND GSE[ETYP]")
geo_shiny(gse_records, client = ellmer::chat_deepseek())
```
